'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Stephen Coovert DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Coovert]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
